notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
oracle-sid-brute NSE iterates a wordlist against the Oracle TNS listener to discover valid SIDs (System Identifiers). Without a valid SID, connection attempts fail even with correct credentials. SID discovery is the mandatory first step for Oracle enumeration.

=== COMMON SIDS ===
XE, ORCL, DB, PROD, hostname-based SIDs. Try these manually first before full brute force. odat.py sidguesser module uses a more comprehensive wordlist.

=== CHAINING ===
oracle-sid-brute → valid SID → odat.py all modules → credential brute force → sysdba escalation → sys.user$ hash extraction → file upload to web root.
